endpoints.security_notes: Requires StrictOperatorAccess. Accepts JSON payload. Validates allowed_types set. Crudely checks for 'raw_chain_of_thought' or 'private_reasoning' strings in JSON body via string search. Does NOT redact secrets, protected paths, or large contents. data field is free-form dict.
Requires OperatorAccess. Reads from trace.ndjson file on disk. Returns raw events as-is. No redaction on retrieval.
Requires OperatorAccess. Returns SSE stream from in-memory queue. Events broadcasted by _broadcast_trace_event. No redaction on stream.
Frontend fetches from /brain/agent-trace/latest. Trusts backend to provide safe events. No frontend redaction layer.
Frontend connects SSE to /brain/agent-trace/stream. Trusts backend. No frontend redaction.

internal_functions.security_notes: Called by live chat binding. No HTTP auth. Bypasses StrictOperatorAccess. Emits directly to queue and file. Risk: if caller passes sensitive data, it is stored unredacted.
Crude string check for 'raw_chain_of_thought' / 'private_reasoning' in JSON body. Does NOT sanitize secrets, tokens, protected paths, or large contents. Writes to trace.ndjson.
Broadcasts raw event to all SSE queues. No redaction. All connected clients receive identical payload.

gaps: No schema validation beyond crude string search.
No protection for secrets, tokens, passwords in data field.
No redaction for protected paths in data field.
No truncation for large file contents or large strings.
Frontend trusts backend completely; no defense-in-depth.
_emit_agent_trace_internal bypasses auth and has no redaction gate.
